title: Canonical Weil structure on the constant coefficient object
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum [def-weil-finite-field-fiber] $p,a,q,k_0,k$, a prime $\ell\neq p$, an algebraic closure $\Qlb$ of $\Ql=\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure], and a finite extension $E/\Ql$ contained in $\Qlb$, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi_E$, finite coefficient rings $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ ($n\geq1$) and reductions $r_n:A_{E,n+1}\twoheadrightarrow A_{E,n}$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Y_0$ be a finite-type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties] $k_0$-scheme, $Y=Y_0\times_{k_0}k$, and $g_Y:Y\to Y$ the geometric-Frobenius automorphism [def-weil-frobenius-detailed], an isomorphism of schemes; $\ell$ is invertible on $Y$.

1. *Finite level.* For $n\geq1$ let $(A_{E,n})_Y$ be the constant sheaf of rings on the small pro-etale site $Y_{\mathrm{proet}}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let
$$
 c_n=c^{g_Y}_{A_{E,n}}:g_Y^{-1}(A_{E,n})_Y\longrightarrow(A_{E,n})_Y
$$
be the structure map of the pro-etale inverse image along $g_Y$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]: the morphism of sheaves of rings adjoint, under $g_Y^{-1}\dashv g_{Y*}$, to the map $(A_{E,n})_Y\to g_{Y*}(A_{E,n})_Y$ induced by sending $a\in A_{E,n}$ to the constant section $a$ over every object. Each $c_n$ is an isomorphism, and $(r_n)_Y\circ c_{n+1}=c_n\circ g_Y^{-1}((r_n)_Y)$ for every $n$ [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image].

2. *Integral level.* Let $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}=\varprojlim_n(A_{E,n})_Y$ be the completed integral coefficient sheaf [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], an inverse limit of sheaves of rings [def-pur-sheaf-inverse-limit]. Define
$$
 c_{\mathcal O_E}:g_Y^{-1}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\longrightarrow\varprojlim_ng_Y^{-1}(A_{E,n})_Y\xrightarrow{\ \varprojlim_nc_n\ }\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y},
$$
the first arrow being the canonical comparison map induced by the inverse images of the projections; the second arrow is defined by the compatibility in 1. Both arrows are isomorphisms [lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image], so $c_{\mathcal O_E}$ is an isomorphism of sheaves of rings.

3. *Derived integral level.* $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ placed in degree $0$ is an object of $D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)$ [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible]. Let $\lambda:Lg_Y^*\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\xrightarrow{\sim}g_Y^{-1}\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ be the isomorphism identifying the derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] along the isomorphism $g_Y$ with the inverse image [lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback], and put
$$
 \theta_{\mathcal O_E}=c_{\mathcal O_E}\circ\lambda:Lg_Y^*\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}\quad\text{in }D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E).
$$

4. *Rational level.* Let $E_Y$ be the image of $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ in the rationalized category $D^b_c(Y,E)=D^b_c(Y,\mathcal O_E)[1/\varpi_E]$ [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], on which the derived pullback $Lg_Y^*$ is induced from integral representatives [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Put $\theta_E=\theta_{\mathcal O_E}\otimes1:Lg_Y^*E_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}E_Y$, the image of $\theta_{\mathcal O_E}$, an isomorphism. Since $\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,Y}$ is a sheaf placed in degree $0$, $E_Y$ lies in the constructible heart $\Sh_c(Y,E)$ [def-weil-constructible-heart], so $(E_Y,\theta_E)$ is a constructible $E$-Weil sheaf and an object of $D^b_{c,\mathrm W}(Y,E)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex]. It is the *canonical Weil structure* on $E_Y$, and $\operatorname{For}(E_Y,\theta_E)=E_Y$.

5. *Algebraically closed coefficients.* The *canonical Weil structure* on $(\Qlb)_Y$ is the object $(\Ql,((\Ql)_Y,\theta_{\Ql}))$ of $D^b_{c,\mathrm W}(Y,\Qlb)=\operatorname{2-colim}_{E}D^b_{c,\mathrm W}(Y,E)$ [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], given at the stage $E=\Ql$ of the directed set of finite extensions of $\Ql$ in $\Qlb$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Its image under $\operatorname{For}$ is $(\Ql,(\Ql)_Y)$, which is the object $(\Qlb)_Y$ of $D^b_c(Y,\Qlb)$ [lem-weil-constant-coefficient-objects-constructible].

split_report.summary: The blueprint names but does not construct this structure (def-weil-ordinary-compact-cohomology, order 1510), so the statement was checked against the definitions it uses. Corrected: (a) c_A was described as 'inverse to the adjunction unit on constant sections', which is not a map g^{-1}A_Y -> A_Y; it is now the structure map of the pro-etale inverse image (adjoint of A_Y -> g_*A_Y), new node def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, which the DAG lacked (def-weil-pbc-inverse-image is the etale one); (b) the integral isomorphism needs g^{-1} to commute with the inverse limit, true because g_Y is an isomorphism: split off as lem-weil-proetale-isomorphism-inverse-image, together with the isomorphy of c_n and its compatibility with reductions; (c) 'Lg^* agrees with g^{-1}' (the old text justified it by exactness of g^{-1}, which does not by itself remove the tensor with g^{-1}A over A or the integral derived-limit recipe) is split off as lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback; (d) the claim that the Qlb object is independent of the stage E with theta_E (x) L = theta_L is removed from the definition, which now fixes the stage E = Ql, and stated as lem-weil-constant-weil-structure-stage-independence (unsplit; no node uses it yet). Added statement dependencies for the notions used (l-adic numbers, algebraic closure, coefficient extension, inverse limit of sheaves, derived-complete integral category, constructible heart). Mathlib (CategoryTheory/Sites/ConstantSheaf.lean equivCommuteConstant, Sites/Equivalence.lean sheafCongr, AlgebraicGeometry/Sites/Proetale.lean) has the general site-theoretic tools but no functoriality of the small pro-etale site.
